runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game ij_l7 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --handle-mechanics <15|7> --watch-wpc-custom-switch 121 --watch-wpc-custom-switch 122 --watch-wpc-custom-switch 123 --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/wpc-dcs/ij-idol-test.json --dmd-dir <external-dmd-dir> --output <external-run.json>. Mask 15 enables all four ij_handleMech mechanisms including bit 3, the idol, which writes public 121-123; mask 7 keeps the drop targets and mini-playfield but removes idol position feedback. The --watch-wpc-custom-switch reads come from PinMAME's model; observed_switch_addresses lists the idol switches at 1 after each press.
